orchestration_result.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

bonds.analysis: To build a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities, we will distribute the portfolio across each year from 1 to 5. This approach ensures a steady stream of cash flows and reduces reinvestment risk. Each maturity bucket will be allocated 20% of the portfolio, adhering to the constraint that no more than 30% can be allocated to a single maturity year. This laddered structure also helps to maintain a balanced portfolio duration, which is expected to be around 3 years, well below the 7-year warning threshold and the 10-year maximum limit. The bonds selected will be from developed markets and will have credit ratings of BBB+ or higher to ensure investment-grade quality.

orchestration_result.final_recommendation: Allocate 20% to US Treasury Bonds (1-year maturity), 20% to German Bunds (2-year maturity), 20% to Japanese Government Bonds (3-year maturity), 20% to UK Gilts (4-year maturity), and 20% to French OATs (5-year maturity), all of which are investment-grade securities. This laddered bond portfolio adheres to the 5-year horizon and maintains a balanced portfolio duration of 3 years.
